title: Your first graph, with no model at all

questions.q: A node on your canvas did nothing when you pressed Queue, and there is no error. What is the most likely reason?
options: Its output never reaches an output node
ComfyUI only runs the first nodes you added
questions.answer: Its output never reaches an output node
questions.why: The engine starts from output nodes and pulls backwards. A node with no path to one is never started.

questions.q: You connect your negative prompt to the positive socket of KSampler. What happens?
options: It runs, and the picture is wrong
questions.answer: It runs, and the picture is wrong
questions.why: Both carry CONDITIONING, so types match. Types can't catch a wire that is legal but silly.

questions.q: What does the number 0xF5C518 mean to EmptyImage?
options: Red 245, green 197, blue 24 packed into one number
questions.answer: Red 245, green 197, blue 24 packed into one number
questions.why: generate() shifts out each byte and divides by 255.

questions.q: You delete SaveImage from a graph and press Queue. What does the server say?
questions.why: validate_prompt collects output nodes first. With none, it stops there.
